title: Sr. Analog IC Design Engineer
desc:
About Siliconroad Semiconductor
Siliconroad Semiconductor is a well-funded, fast-moving startup founded in July 2022. We specialize in ASIC development for global markets, with a focus on high-performance analog and mixed-analog chip design. Our products are used in a variety of applications, including automotive and industrial lidar, optical communication, and RF/MMIC. Our team is led by experienced founders and composed of talented engineers from around the world, with R&D centers in China, Turkey, and Germany.
What You'll Do (Responsibilities)
Design and simulate high-performance analog/mixed-signal circuit blocks such as data converters (ADC/DAC), amplifiers, LDOs, and PLLs.
Take ownership of the design from architectural definition and transistor-level design through layout supervision and post-layout verification.
Create detailed design and verification documentation.
Collaborate with layout, verification, and system engineers to ensure robust and successful product delivery.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews.
Participate in the evaluation and characterization of fabricated silicon in the lab.
What You'll Bring (Qualifications)
A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
A minimum of 3 years
of hands-on experience in analog/mixed-signal IC design.
Proven experience with deep sub-micron CMOS processes.
Proficiency with industry-standard design and simulation tools (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre).
Solid understanding of analog design fundamentals, including device physics, noise, and matching.
Experience in supervising IC layout and interpreting post-layout simulation results.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
Why Join Us?
Make an Impact:
Be a key part of a fast-growing startup and see your work directly influence our cutting-edge products.
Global Team:
Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers from around the world.
Innovation:
Work on exciting and challenging projects in high-growth industries.
Growth Opportunity:
Develop your skills and grow your career as our company expands.
How to Apply?
Interested in this opportunity? Please apply through the "Easy Apply" button on LinkedIn.
